svg.title: Stacks e tecnologias
svg.desc: Banner animado com 28 tecnologias: CSS, HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, Haskell, Markdown, PowerShell, Vue, Node, Vite, NPM, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite, Git, GitHub, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Docker, Netlify, Windows Terminal, Canva, Figma, Notion, Prettier e SonarQube.
